text:
You are a work-tracking assistant. Read this conversation excerpt and extract ONLY concrete work-management events that should be recorded in a project tracker.

Capture:
  capture_idea    — a new task/feature/problem surfaced and worth tracking. Requires a real title (not vague), an area, and a brief why.
  advance_issue   — an existing tracked item whose status changed (started/finished/blocked/cancelled). Requires title_hint + new_status + what_happened.
  log_decision    — a firm project-level decision with rationale AND at least one rejected alternative explicitly stated. Do NOT capture soft preferences.
  capture_bet     — a confident directional wager. Requires statement, rationale, confidence (0.0–1.0), evidence_needed.

Rules:
  - Only emit events for things EXPLICITLY stated, not implied.
  - Skip meta-conversation, tool output, system messages, planning already in tracker.
  - Decisions without rejected alternatives: skip.
  - If nothing qualifies: emit empty events list.

IMPORTANT OUTPUT FORMAT RULES — follow exactly:
- Respond with ONLY a valid JSON object.
- Start your response with { and end with }
- No prose, no explanation, no markdown, no code fences.
- Every field in the schema is required unless marked optional.

JSON Schema (AutoCaptureResult)
Fields:
  events (optional): array of object(type: one of: "capture_idea", "advance_issue", "log_decision", "capture_bet", title: string, area: string, why: string, title_hint: string, new_status: one of: "idea", "planned", "in-progress", "done", "blocked", "cancelled", what_happened: string, decision: string, rationale: string, alternatives_rejected: array of string, statement: string, confidence: number, evidence_needed: string)

Text to analyze:
...[truncated]...
rget band. Expert-rated protocol quality.
  [6] Net relevant yield (absolute size of the pipeline's final relevant set vs gold size, conditioned on precision + adjudicated-novel fraction) is a better M1 success metric than recall-against-gold, and the pipeline delivers MORE genuine relevant papers than the human gold (yield ratio > 1 at high precision). | confidence: 0.6 | logged: 2026-06-06
      evidence needed: Report per domain: recall vs gold; precision of final set; |final relevant set|/|gold|; adjudicated-genuine fraction of novel (non-gold) finds. Yield ratio > 1 at precision held high, across >=2 domains.
  [7] The novel relevant papers our pipeline finds beyond the human gold MATERIALLY CHANGE the review's conclusion (counterfactual conclusion-shift), not just add bulk — measurable as a shift in the synthesis output (extinction-cause attribution distribution / dissent map) when including gold+novel vs gold-only. | confidence: 0.45 | logged: 2026-06-06
      evidence needed: Compute attribution/dissent distribution on gold-only vs gold+adjudicated-novel; measure Jensen-Shannon divergence + per-driver count shifts. Shift => completeness is substantive not cosmetic. Also: novel KG nodes added; diversity delta. Stewart-only initially (M3 limited to Stewart).

OPEN EXPERIMENTS (3):
  [4] A scoping/intake step that produces a well-formed PECO protocol + breadth-bounded queries raises retrieval recall and reduces its cross-domain variance vs the current ad-hoc query generation. | findings: 0
  [5] The pipeline's final relevant set is larger than the human gold at high precision (net relevant yield ratio > 1), making it a more complete review than the original. | findings: 0
  [6] Including the novel (non-gold) relevant papers shifts the review's synthesis conclusion (extinction-cause attribution distribution) vs gold-only — i.e. the extra papers change the answer, not just the count. | findings: 0
